item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #SLPRSD
Issued at 06:25 PM 27 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #CamarinesSur(Balatan, Nabua, Bato), #Masbate(PioV.Corpuz, Cataingan, Palanas, Placer, Esperanza and Dimasalang) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #CamarinesSur(Bula, Baao), #NorthernSamar(SanAntonio, SanVicente, Capul, Biri, Lavezares, Allen, Victoria, SanIsidro, Rosario, SanJose, Bobon, Catarman and LopeDeVega) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
